findings: The current announcement sends shoppers to the general sunglasses collection instead of the original site's dedicated Sale Sunglasses page.
Both messages navigate within the same tab; neither opens a modal or applies a sale filter.
Both close buttons hide the announcement and store a dismissal flag in sessionStorage.
The planned /collections/sale-sunglasses destination and the current navigation's /collections/sale destination both return storefront 404 responses.
recommendation: Make the intended Sale Sunglasses collection publicly available and populate it with the intended sale products, then assign it to the announcement block's Link setting.
changed: Only audit evidence was written. No theme code, products, collections, or store settings changed.
